name: unsupported-browser-notice
title: Unsupported browser notice
description: A calm notice for a browser that cannot run your app: what is missing in plain words, which browsers work, and Continue anyway.
docs: requires lists what the app needs: each entry has a label, shown when it is missing, and a test, either a function that returns false when the browser lacks it or data such as { css: "container-type: inline-size" } or { api: "IntersectionObserver" }, which also works from a Server Component. browsers lists the browsers that work, each with its name, minVersion and the official href. When the visitor's browser can be read from its user agent, is on the list and is older, the notice says so and its card shows the version it has. The checks run once the page is live, so the server renders nothing, and a browser that passes every check gets no notice and no gap. Continue anyway is always offered, is remembered for the session under storageKey and calls onContinue; dismissible adds a close button that hides it for this page view only and calls onDismiss. Above your content it pushes the page down once when it appears; give it className="fixed inset-x-4 bottom-4 z-50" to float it over the page instead, and add max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] overflow-y-auto if a screen can be shorter than the notice, so it scrolls instead of running off the top. userAgent overrides the visitor's own, for previews and tests. labels carries every word.
